title: Conditional assignment driven by enum-state equality (P2A HALT shape)
license: internal regression test, no external reference
problemDescription: FSM cycles S_IDLE -> S_RUN -> S_DONE on rising clk after go='1'. A concurrent conditional assignment `flag <= '1' when state = S_DONE else '0'` should assert flag once state reaches S_DONE. Mirrors P2A's `halted <= '1' when state = S_HALT else '0'`. Tests enum-literal resolution inside ConditionalAssignment.
